detail.longDescription: It's unfortunate that probably for the rest of my life I will by default avoid reading papers posted in the 2020s. I look forward to finding out whether the same will be true of the 2030s onward, or if most everything I'll ever read or cite has already been posted. On a related note, I sometimes wonder which languages I should be writing in or translating into for future readers. I am most actively working on my Spanish, but perhaps Mandarin or an African language like Akan would be better. It was thanks to Arabic translations that we have access to a bunch of ancient Greek and Latin literature, after all. # math # mathematics # language # Spanish # Mandarin # Africa # Akan # research # preservation # literature # Greek # Latin # Arabic # translation # history
